title: Kagamine Len — Big-Time Breakfast〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
KAITO and Luka's drinks are ready.
Can you take these to them for me, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: If you want your drink so badly, then why don't you come get it yourself?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Thank you for waiting, Len, Rin.
Here are the drinks you ordered.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Mmm! So good!
There really is nothing better than a cool glass of juice after a tough practice!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! We could have a quick bite while we're here...
Thank goodness! We're still actually able to come here!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You're here? Shouldn't you all be in the US?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
We're actually here with some gifts.
Here they are...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Wow! These boxes are so big!
One, two, three... Six in total!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
What do you think they are?
Oh, they smell really nice...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So, these are what you'd call “American sized”...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Even we thought we made a mistake with our order when they arrived at our table.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Look how shocked they are! These were totally worth bringing over!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: There are several different kinds, so please feel free to choose whichever ones you like.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
This one with cheese looks good!
Could you get a knife and fork for me, MEIKO?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
A knife and fork?
You're not going to use your hands?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
These look a little too big for that.
Also, I'd rather not get my hands and face all greasy.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I figured you wouldn't worry about that kind of thing.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But how are you actually supposed to eat one of these?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: If the patty is closer to the bottom, then it's apparently good to flip it upside down.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: And if it's too big to bite into, then you could try crushing it a bit.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Really?! But crushing it doesn't seem right.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Let's do our best to bite into them as they are!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: When you pick them up, you'll need to make sure the toppings don't slide off.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Actually, are your hands even big enough to handle one of these?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Hey, no teasing.
It's still just a hamburger...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
No, you guys!
Everything's gonna slide off if you hold them like that!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, right! Th-Then, how about like this?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That's good! All you have to do now is take a bite!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Th-This is really good...!
And this patty's so juicy!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Huh?! I only got a part of the bun!
Lemme take another bite...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. Why don't we also get started while they're still warm?
